registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Firmware-visible control register. Provides global enable, arm, mode selection, and interrupt enable masking through Wishbone decode.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: Global enable for request issuance, safety authorization, and command propagation.

fields.name: ARM
fields.description: Arm bit required before request emission and actuator command validity may be asserted.

fields.name: MODE
fields.description: Operating mode selection used as request metadata.

fields.name: IRQ_ENABLE
fields.description: Interrupt enable mask for response-ready, stale-data, timeout, and fault causes.

registers.name: VELOCITY_SETPOINT
registers.description: Requested velocity setpoint used by the request formatter as compact command metadata.

fields.name: VELOCITY_SETPOINT
fields.description: Velocity setpoint in firmware-defined units.

registers.name: CLAMP_MIN
registers.description: Minimum actuator clamp for saturating the registered actuator command.

fields.name: CLAMP_MIN
fields.description: Lower bound for actuator command clamping.

registers.name: CLAMP_MAX
registers.description: Maximum actuator clamp for saturating the registered actuator command.

fields.name: CLAMP_MAX
fields.description: Upper bound for actuator command clamping.

registers.name: TIMEOUT_THRESHOLD
registers.description: Bounded timeout threshold used by deterministic stale and missing-response supervision.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_THRESHOLD
fields.description: Maximum allowed local tick age before timeout is asserted.

registers.name: SEQUENCE_COUNTER
registers.description: Firmware-maintained request sequence number used for request metadata and response validation.

fields.name: SEQUENCE_COUNTER
fields.description: Sequence number written by firmware and consumed by request formatting and supervision.

registers.name: FAULT_CLEAR_W1C
registers.description: Write-one-to-clear fault register. Each written one clears the corresponding sticky fault bit; zero leaves the bit unchanged.

fields.name: FAULT_CLEAR_W1C
fields.description: Sticky-fault clear mask.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Readable status register exposing sticky faults, response-ready, freshness, stale, timeout, and last seen sequence.

fields.name: FAULT_STICKY
fields.description: Sticky fault summary, latched until reset or write-one-to-clear.

fields.name: RESPONSE_READY
fields.description: Indicates that a response packet was accepted and decoded.

fields.name: FRESH
fields.description: Freshness indication from the response/safety supervision path.

fields.name: STALE
fields.description: Stale-data indication from deterministic supervision.

fields.name: TIMEOUT
fields.description: Timeout indication from deterministic supervision.

fields.name: LAST_SEEN_SEQUENCE
fields.description: Last accepted response sequence observed by the safety supervisor.

registers.name: ACTUATOR_CMD
registers.description: Registered actuator command output as observed by firmware.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_CMD
fields.description: Registered 32-bit actuator command value after clamp and safety gating.

fields.name: RESPONSE_READY
fields.description: Interrupt cause for response-ready event.

fields.name: STALE
fields.description: Interrupt cause for stale-data detection.

fields.name: TIMEOUT
fields.description: Interrupt cause for timeout detection.

fields.name: FAULT
fields.description: Interrupt cause for sticky fault transition or assertion.
